title: CSME EndPoint Error Fix
symptom: Shows '[ME Error] EndPoint error occurred' or fails to pass CSME initial handshake on POST
description: Resets the CSME EndPoint error flag in the descriptor/ME region and restores clean host firmware communication.
author: R1 LAB

title: Display Delay 30s Fix
symptom: Power button lights up immediately, but screen remains completely black for 30 to 45 seconds before showing HP logo
description: Resets the HP ME configuration timeout and initializes ME/BIOS fast boot flags to eliminate the 30-second POST delay.
author: R1 LAB

title: Onboard RAM Disable
symptom: Onboard RAM faulty / 3-5 Beeps / Black screen until onboard RAM is removed
description: Disables soldered onboard DDR4 memory channel in BIOS memory mapping tables, allowing normal boot via SODIMM slot.
author: R1 LAB

title: Manufacturing Mode 0x33 Warning Clear
symptom: Shows 'Manufacturing Mode Active' or Error 0x33 during POST, requiring F1 to continue
description: Sets the ME Manufacturing Mode flag to closed/disabled in Flash Partition Table and NVAR settings to suppress the 0x33 warning.
author: R1 LAB
